question: Can you calculate the 5-day symmetric moving average of predicted toy sales for December 5 to 8, 2018, using daily sales data from January 1, 2017, to August 29, 2018, with a simple linear regression model? Finally provide the sum of those four 5-day moving averages?
sql:
WITH toy_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY DATE(o.order_purchase_timestamp)) AS day_num,
        DATE(o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS sale_date,
        SUM(oi.price) AS daily_sales
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    JOIN product_category_name_translation pct ON p.product_category_name = pct.product_category_name
    WHERE pct.product_category_name_english = 'toys'
      AND DATE(o.order_purchase_timestamp) >= '2017-01-01'
      AND DATE(o.order_purchase_timestamp) <= '2018-08-29'
    GROUP BY DATE(o.order_purchase_timestamp)
),
regression AS (
    SELECT 
        REGR_SLOPE(daily_sales, day_num) AS slope,
        REGR_INTERCEPT(daily_sales, day_num) AS intercept
    FROM toy_orders
),
all_pred_days AS (
    SELECT 698 AS day_num UNION ALL SELECT 699 UNION ALL SELECT 700 UNION ALL SELECT 701
    UNION ALL SELECT 702 UNION ALL SELECT 703 UNION ALL SELECT 704 UNION ALL SELECT 705
),
predictions AS (
    SELECT 
        apd.day_num,
        r.slope * apd.day_num + r.intercept AS predicted_sales
    FROM all_pred_days apd
    CROSS JOIN regression r
),
day_to_date AS (
    SELECT 700 AS day_num, '2018-12-05'::DATE AS pred_date UNION ALL
    SELECT 701, '2018-12-06' UNION ALL
    SELECT 702, '2018-12-07' UNION ALL
    SELECT 703, '2018-12-08'
),
ma_calc AS (
    SELECT 
        dtd.pred_date,
        dtd.day_num,
        AVG(p.predicted_sales) AS ma_5day
    FROM day_to_date dtd
    JOIN predictions p ON p.day_num BETWEEN dtd.day_num - 2 AND dtd.day_num + 2
    GROUP BY dtd.pred_date, dtd.day_num
)
SELECT SUM(ma_5day) AS sum_of_four_ma_5day FROM ma_calc
